title: Return policy page found
question: Can an agent find and read the return policy?
method: Follow the home-page link whose label or path names returns, refunds, exchanges, withdrawal, Widerruf, Rückgabe, retour, reso or their equivalents, as whole words. A label made of policy words outranks a product name that carries the word, a footer link outranks a body link, and product, listing and account URLs are never chosen; on Shopify the platform's own policy page replaces a pick matched by path alone. Fail when the linked page is a product page rather than a policy, when it is not fetchable or when no link is found; warn when it carries 100 words or fewer; pass otherwise. Every checkout programme (Google Merchant Center and UCP, the OpenAI feed, Stripe, Shopify channels) asks for a return policy URL.

spec.title: Google Merchant Center: shopping ads policies (contact and policy requirements)

title: Shipping policy page found
question: Can an agent find shipping costs, regions and delivery times?
method: The same link heuristics for shipping, delivery, Versand, Lieferung, livraison, spedizione, envío and their compounds (Versandkosten counts, Versandlager does not). Fail when the linked page is a product page or not fetchable; warn when it does not mention regions, costs or delivery times; pass otherwise.

title: Privacy policy and terms found
question: Are the privacy policy and terms of service linked and fetchable?
method: Look for link labels or paths matching privacy, Datenschutz, terms, AGB, conditions, T&Cs and their equivalents, ranked the same way, so that Terms of Service outranks Promo T&Cs. Pass when both pages answer 200; warn when one does; fail when neither does. When a page was linked but could not be read, the message names the link and the response.

title: Merchant identity
question: Who is selling, where are they, and how can they be reached?
method: Pass when Organization JSON-LD (name, address or contactPoint) exists, or an imprint or about page carries a legal name and address.

title: Contact channel
question: Can an agent or its user find a way to contact the merchant?
method: Pass when the home page links a mailto: address, a tel: number, or a same-origin contact, support, help or customer-service page (the words must stand alone in a short label or in the last path segment, and product or listing pages never count); warn when only a cross-origin contact link exists; fail when none. The message names a page. Google Merchant Center requires a contact method on the site, and UCP onboarding asks for at least one.

spec.title: Google Merchant Center: shopping ads policies (contact and policy requirements)

title: Policy pages are agent-readable
question: Can an agent actually read the policy pages it found?
method: For each policy page found (returns, shipping, privacy, terms), require HTTP 200, more than 100 words of text outside scripts, and no robots.txt rule that disallows the search and assistant crawlers of A2.2 on its path. Pass when all found pages qualify; warn when some do not, or when a page carries noindex (reachable for every fetcher, but kept out of the indexes that ground AI answers, as Shopify policy pages are by default); fail when none qualifies. Skip when no policy page was found.

title: security.txt
question: Does the site publish a security contact?
method: Informational. GET /.well-known/security.txt. Pass on a text document with Contact: and Expires: fields whose Expires date is in the future; warn when a field is missing or expired; not applicable when absent. Operational maturity, not agent readiness: reported, never scored.
